TEXT:
[FI] And with that, Kirino went quiet... An awkward 
silence grew between us.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Back then... you said the following.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Reasons that are my own business. I can't and don't 
plan on telling you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] I'm afraid I can't help you guys out.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] I don't plan on telling you, didn't I say that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I know that and that's why I'm asking.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] I know what you want to say.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] It's about Saori, the black one, and even Ayase too, 
right?

[FI] Kirino pinpointed exactly what I wanted to talk 
about.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Those girls are all opposed to Kanako and I dating.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] I know. We talked about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] I also know that things don't look good the way 
they are now.

[FI] It was as if she got over something or she might've 
prepared herself...

[FI] She had an encouraging smile befitting of my little 
sister.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Is there anything that I can do?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Hmm, nah, it's not like there's nothing but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Don't you think you should return to your room for 
now?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] The games I lent you and the game I gave to you 
as a present, aren't they all in your room right now?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ayase, let's play this game together.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, it's the game Kirino was playing yesterday.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] I-I-Isn't that one of those H-Games?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] Yeah! I'll make every nook and cranny sparkle!
[FI] I sprinted up the stairs with a mad dash.
